text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) had 
finally arrived, setting the stage for the 
showdown between the 'Big Three.'

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for "BNW" up until that point, it seems 
the three of them had been spending their 
usual time together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The place where they pour their hearts 
against one another is out on the turf—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Harboring a quiet fighting spirit within, 
Narita Taishin heads toward the 
battlefield.
